title: Readout from Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with UAE Minister of State for Financial Affairs H.E. Mohamed bin Hadi Al Hussaini
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with UAE Minister of State for Financial Affairs on April 14, 2026, to discuss Iran's missile strikes against the UAE. Bessent expressed U.S. solidarity with the UAE and stated the U.S. aims to deter future attacks and prevent further energy market disruption. Both officials also discussed maintaining 'maximum pressure' sanctions against Iran.

A key U.S. objective is ensuring energy markets are not further impacted by Iran
